GOAL: orient in the workspace before writing the ideation answer.
READ: listed the working directory only so far.
OBSERVED: session cwd is results/research/issue121/rounds/round_20261029_030015_260/agents/ideation_1.
REASONING: need to inspect repo mechanisms (esp. results/research/issue126 prefix-rank proxy, RQ-VAE SID code) to avoid restating rejected ideas.
OPEN: read CLAUDE.md sections 19/19g and issue126 artefacts.

GOAL: choose one in-scope coupling mechanism distinct from the repository's prior SID ideas.
READ: the task brief (scope contract, experiment policy, prior-round list, Issue #126 finding) and the available tool catalog; repository files were not readable from this sandbox (read/glob returned permission denied / no files), so the design is constrained to the mechanisms named in the brief.
OBSERVED: prior rounds already cover successor-diffused assignment mass in a Poincare Sinkhorn quantizer, successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates, per-branch/per-cell curvature (KAPPA_BRANCH, CURVCELL), geodesic shells, Lorentz cones, tangent residuals, behaviour-anchored charts, and mixed-curvature fibres. All were math=INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_RUN.
REASONING: the uncovered position is the assignment METRIC itself, not the assignment mass, codebook mean, residual or curvature scalar. Chosen mechanism: a rank-one anisotropic tangent metric in a trainable-curvature Poincare ball, with the anisotropy axis given by the geodesic direction to the item's training co-successor centroid and the anisotropy strength given by the measured concentration of that co-successor distribution. This makes the behaviour term an axis+direction-dependent distortion, not a scalar weight, and it leaves levels 2..L and the decoder Euclidean, so the intervention is local to level 1 (the level where Issue #126's Q_H diagnostic was predictive).
OPEN: write the full one-block specification with equations, switches, safeguards and frozen-scale cost.

FINAL ANSWER (beh-aniso-poincare-l1): one idea, level-1 behaviour-axis anisotropic Poincare metric. Behaviour signal: co-successor relation of directed training transitions, giving per-item sibling weights q_i and concentration beta_i = 1 - H(q_i)/log m_i. Curved operator: Poincare ball with trainable curvature kappa, distance d_P and Mobius displacement w = (-z) + c; anisotropy A_i = I + (sqrt(1+beta_i)-1) u_i u_i^T in the tangent space at z_i. Coupling score: D_i(z,c_k)^2 = (1 + beta_i cos^2 theta_ik) d_P(z,c_k)^2, with theta_ik the angle between the Poincare displacement to c_k and the displacement to the sibling Einstein midpoint a_i. Switches: beta=0 gives the geometry-only arm (exact d_P), kappa->0 / Euclidean log gives the behaviour-only arm, both on is the single trained run. Levels 2..L, reconstruction and decoder stay Euclidean, with level-1 content anchor e_k = log_0(c_k). Safeguards: radius clamp (1-1e-3)/sqrt(kappa), arctanh clamp, kappa in [1e-3,10] init 1.0, beta in [0,1], eps-normalised directions, betai=0 when the sibling set has <2 members or the anchor coincides with z_i, detached bank/anchor/direction, 0.99 EMA bank, standard grad-norm clip. Cost at frozen scale: ~1023 items/step, 72,000 steps, ~0.65M gather MACs plus ~16.8M level-1 distance MACs per step (K1=256, d=64), about +5-10% Stage-2 wall clock and ~7 MB extra memory. No ablation, sweep or seed repetition is run.

STAGE 1 (goal/read/observe). Goal: one further in-scope idea for round_20261029_030015_260, after Issue #126, distinct from all earlier-round mechanisms. Read: the round brief plus the earlier-round outcome list only (this session has no shell/read tools). Observed: every probe in rounds 20261028_212003_968, 20261028_221240_652 and 20261028_233100_128 was INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_RUN, and the only executed candidate was poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (successor-weighted curved codebook means). Occupied positions are therefore: curved assignment/Sinkhorn mass, curved codebook update, per-branch and per-level curvature, tangent/gyro targets, Lorentz cones, hyperbolic prefix score, geodesic charts, code repair, shells, fibre mixing. Reasoning: the one position none of them touched is the item's RADIAL COORDINATE between encoder and quantiser - i.e. a behaviour-determined geodesic displacement of the latent before any assignment happens. Open: whether that displacement survives training (encoder can invert it) and whether sharper level-1 prefixes reach Stage-3 recall.

STAGE 2 (decision). Chosen idea id: succboost-geoshift. One-line: a per-item geodesic pre-shift of the encoder latent, z' = exp_z(beta_i * rhat) at fixed curvature K=-1/R^2, R=0.9, where beta_i = clip(gamma*(cbar - c_i), -1, 1) is read from the successor-entropy concentration c_i of the training-only directed transition counts. Why this and not another assignment/codebook variant: it keeps the frozen pipeline byte-identical except for the argument fed to the quantiser, so cost is ~5% step time, constants are derived (gamma = 1/sigma_c clamped to [0.5,8]; B = 1 curvature-radius unit; R = 0.9 documented default) and therefore no sweep is needed; the three switches (BEHAVIOUR=off sets beta=0; GEOMETRY=off replaces exp map by Euclidean dilation z*exp(beta) and d_P by squared Euclidean) exist in code but no arm is trained. Story: level-1 cells fill with behaviourally predictable items and diffuse hubs are resolved at levels 2-3, which is the quantity Issue #126's hard prefix score Q_H was ranking. Open: sign of the effect, and whether the encoder cancels the shift.

STAGE 3 (final answer delivered in the response, id succboost-geoshift). The complete idea block was printed in the reply because this session has no write path; its core is: COUPLING EQUATION k1(i) = argmin_k d_P( exp_{z_i}(beta_i * rhat_i), c_{1,k} ), beta_i = clip(gamma*(cbar - c_i), -1, 1), gamma = clip(1/sigma_c, 0.5, 8), rhat_i = z_i/||z_i||, curvature K = -1/R^2, R = 0.9. BEHAVIOUR: successor-entropy concentration c_i of the directed transition counts T[i,j] from the Stage-2 training split only, Laplace smoothed, frozen before epoch 1, beta = 0 for items without successors, no val/test interaction can enter. GEOMETRY: Poincare exp map along the item's own radial geodesic plus Poincare assignment and Moebius residual chain. LOCATION: encoder head -> quantiser input, inside training and inside quantisation, not a side loss, no Stage-3 change. SWITCHES (present but not run): BEHAVIOUR=off beta=0; GEOMETRY=off z*exp(beta) with squared Euclidean distances. OBSERVABLES: Spearman(beta, artanh(||z||/R)) target > 0.3, level-1 successor purity, level-1 usage entropy, SID flip rate, Stage-3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065. COST: ~1023-item batch per step at 24556/24, 3 x 1023 x 256 Poincare distances per step, +4-6% step time, <5% wall clock over 3000 epochs x 24 steps, one-off beta precompute of seconds. RISK: encoder can invert the shift (detected by the radius-beta correlation); origin crowding/dead level-1 codes; arcosh instability near the boundary.
